Exactly TWO large clear arrows: desk to basket, basket to album. Keep all stations fully visible with generous whitespace, equal scale, clear conceptual distinction. Tiny friendly human hands optional, no full people needed. The desk/basket/album analogy must be recognizable, arrows unobstructed. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO filenames, NO logos, NO QR code, NO additional arrows, no dark background. This is an instructional interior textbook figure, not a restaurant scene.
